items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Do you remember Danny Barker? Oh, yes, I do remember. I write to him. ... He's a great guy.

ctx.x: Now, tell me about some of those New Orleans bands you heard here, Autumn.

This is Autumn Goods. That's right. I heard Celestan and I heard Louis Armstrong. Who is Louis Armstrong? You know who Louis Armstrong is. Don't you know, Papa? No, I don't know him. Tell me about it. You don't, bro. He's one of those great popper killers. Yeah. I heard of him. Somewhere else. And then we had a band from New Orleans came here by the name of, um, I don't know. I can't remember all those other names. It's been so long. Do you remember Danny Barker? Oh, yes, I do remember. I write to him. You do…
